sources.note: No GitHub issue this cycle; topics seeded from the pre-meetup research packet.

topics.title: News Roundup - July
topics.summary: Cross-topic roundup with focused slides for Core privatebroadcast IP leak, BIP-452 P2P UTXO-set sharing with an AssumeUTXO explainer, wallet/dependency work (Branch-and-Bound, libevent removal, RBF signalling, compaction and secp256k1 performance), Core process (meta#46), Project Loupe's LDK v0.2.3 security and interop fixes, funding (Maelstrom, OpenSats/Utreexo, Brink Hornet/Bedrock, contribution-spam tooling), privacy (Marmot v2, Payjoin-to-Cashu), self-custody and policy (AUSTRAC Travel Rule, Bitaroo's SHAZAM opt-out, libssh2 RCE, Ledger mail scam), network measurement (b10c connection rates, v2 transport, ASmap dashboard), and a markets slide on Strategy's STRC preferred trading below par (paused ATM issuance, first BTC sale since 2022, 11.50% rate held vs Strive's SATA, and the dividend-sustainability debate). Not sourced from the newswatch packet; STRC facts were web-verified against CoinDesk (June 2026) and are fast-moving.

topics.title: What Is Stacker News?
topics.summary: Speaker-led session by frequent participant OT, with factual grounding added: what Stacker News is (a Lightning-powered link-aggregator and discussion site, pseudonymous, open source, by k00b), how sats change the feed (zapping as the upvote, posting fees for spam resistance, boost, sat-weighted ranking), territories and the rewards pool, a lightweight live-demo agenda for OT, and discussion questions on moderation, identity, rewards and community norms.

topics.title: The August Fork: BIP-110 and Drivechains
topics.summary: Two contentious August events: BIP-110's mandatory-signaling window near block 961,632 (~7 Aug) at near-zero hashrate, 55% threshold, no Core enforcement; and, separately, a Sztorc/LayerTwo Labs hard-fork spinoff chain floated for late August (new SHA-256d chain, one-time difficulty reset, 1:1 airdrop) - BIP-300 itself is the Drivechains (hashrate-escrow) soft fork, not the spinoff. Plus Adam Back and Jameson Lopp's chain-split warnings; the data-carrier backdrop (Blockspace Weekly Alkanes numbers, the Segregated Data counter-proposal); and the BNOC/b10c fork-day monitoring plan. Block heights, dates and signalling figures are fast-moving; re-verify before the meetup.

topics.title: Stratum V2
topics.summary: On 25 June GoMining mined the first known live Bitcoin block with miner-selected transactions via Stratum V2 job declaration on the DMND pool. The deck covers what SV2 job declaration changes (transaction selection moves from pool to miner), adoption (about seven pools, ~75% hashrate, joined the SV2 working group in May, but only Braiins and DMND run SV2 natively; OCEAN uses its own DATUM protocol), the stack (SRI v1.10.0 libraries and v0.5.0 apps on 3 June, Bitcoin Core Mining IPC submitBlock #34644), and the SV2-vs-DATUM debate (Luke Dashjr's criticism). Adoption and hashrate figures are fast-moving; re-verify before the meetup.

topics.title: Post-Quantum Migration
topics.summary: July post-quantum migration deck expanded into one slide per thread: the PQ output type (P2MR/BIP-360 vs P2TRv2) under Wuille's Never/Later/Now framing; the Tripwire and Miner Lockdown proposals for triggering EC disabling (Wuille, Dryja, Sjors); BIP-360 PR #2198 (depth-zero anyone-can-spend, a privacy fix; ~32 weight-unit overhead vs P2TRv2 with the EC key-recovery trick); SHRINCS and the stateful-signing problem; and PACT/Quantum Sunset migration economics.

topics.title: State of Layer 2
topics.summary: A trust-model spectrum: Ark on mainnet without covenants (Second's bark, release train, African settlement pilot); the covenants enabling it (CSFS+CAT demos, nSequence bit-21 expiry); BitVM bridges (Union on Rootstock testnet, Liquid's stated research-stage migration); ecash as a layer (Cashu NUT-30 on-chain, Payjoin-to-Cashu, Fedimint v2 under WASM); statechains (Spark's unchanged 2-operator trust model, Mercury Layer's repo going dark); and Botanix's Spiderchain wind-down.
